name: Lab 1 — System Internals, Virtualization & Logic Design
desc: Audited host hardware and processes with Sysinternals, deployed Kali in VMware, simulated CPU execution and half-adder logic in LMC and CircuitVerse, and mapped ICT attack surfaces.

name: Lab 2 — Data Encoding, Hashing & Obfuscation with CyberChef
desc: Converted binary, hex, and Base64; identified file types from magic bytes; analyzed SHA-256 avalanche integrity; and decoded layered obfuscation to solve a CyberChef CTF challenge.

name: Lab 4 — Disks, Partitions & Digital Forensics in Kali
desc: Analyzed MBR/GPT with GNOME Disks and GParted, inspected 55 AA boot signatures in GHex, and recovered a deleted file from a forensic disk image using Autopsy.
